biggest_catch: The official form publishes almost no program detail — no payout timing, no cap, and no definition of what 'joining' requires beyond the standard membership eligibility. The referrer must be a member in good standing and the referred member must be 18+, but how and when you actually get paid is unstated.
catches: No payout timing or cap is stated on the official referral form.
Referrer must be a member in good standing to participate.
Referred new member must be 18+; previously joined/previous members are not eligible.
No cash value; offer not transferrable.
The official form is served over HTTP (not HTTPS) — the official domain but without transport security.
Offers subject to change or cancellation; disputes cancel all participants' eligibility.
Tax treatment not stated; treat as potentially reportable income.
